text.p: Tropical Cyclone Drena is in the eastern Coral Sea. Top winds are near 140 mph. The storm is centered near 17s/159e and is moving southwest at 4 mph. A turn to the south is expected while the storm begins to weaken slowly this period. By 48 hours, the storm should be west of New Caledonia. The main threat from Drena will be to shipping this period.

Tropical Cyclone Rachel, with 65 mph winds, is off the northwestern Australia coast, northwest of Derby, moving southwestward parallel to the coastline. It may intensify slightly but should remain mostly offshore, threatening shipping. Some of the heavy rainbands may move onshore and cause local flash flooding with heavy rainfall this period over the northwest coastal portion of Australia.

Tropical Cyclone Fabriola is in the Mozambique Channel near 15s/44e, moving west at 10 mph. Top winds are 40 mph but will drop off this period as the storm begins to dissipate. The threat to shipping will decrease.
